textbookText: The blue color is due to the presence of ammoniated electrons which absorbs energy in the visible region of light and thus imparts blue color. As the solution becomes more concentrated, it takes on a bronze color.
Sodium forms sodamide on reaction with ammonia gas on heating. 2 Na + 2 NH3 → 2 NaNH2 + H2
a. It is used in sodium vapour lamps. b. It is used in preparation of sodium extract to detect the presence of hetero element in organic

compounds. c. It is used in many organic reactions like Wurtz reaction, Fittig reaction, Birtch reduction, etc. d. It is used as a catalyst in preparation of artificial rubber. e. It is used in the form of sodium amalgam (Na+Hg) in the preparation of various organic compounds. f. It is used in the extraction of carbon, magnesium and silicon. g. It is used as a reducing agent. h. It is used in the form of sodium chloride which is an important animal nutrient. i. It is used in production of TEL (Tetraethyl lead), an anti-knocking agent. j. It is used as a coolant in nuclear reactors.
